meta.title: WebDecoy Bot Detection Trial
meta.author: cport1
meta.description: Try the public WebDecoy plugin in a disposable WordPress site. Inspect one explicitly labeled setup-test detection and explore local settings without a cloud account.

steps.data:
WebDecoy browser trial — one controlled setup test. This disposable WordPress site installed the public plugin and ran its reserved WebDecoy-Test user agent. The test row below is not real crawler traffic or a detection-accuracy result. Playground startup requests may also appear in the log; none of these rows are visitors to your own site. No WebDecoy account or API key is configured. Explore Detections, Statistics and Settings, then install WebDecoy on your own site. Playground runs in your browser; it does not receive your website traffic.

WEBDECOY_DISABLE : null,'admin'=>function_exists('is_admin') ? is_admin() : null,'ajax'=>function_exists('wp_doing_ajax') ? wp_doing_ajax() : null,'enabled'=>function_exists('get_option') ? (get_option('webdecoy_options',[])['enabled'] ?? null) : null,'init_count'=>function_exists('did_action') ? did_action('init') : null];
    $d['status'] = http_response_code();
    $d['plugin_version'] = defined('WEBDECOY_VERSION') ? WEBDECOY_VERSION : null;
    $d['db_error'] = isset($GLOBALS['wpdb']) ? $GLOBALS['wpdb']->last_error : null;
    $d['registered'] = function_exists('webdecoy') && function_exists('has_action') ? has_action('init', [webdecoy(), 'early_check']) : null;
    if (isset($GLOBALS['wpdb'])) { $db=$GLOBALS['wpdb']; $d['rows']=$db->get_results("SELECT user_agent,flags FROM {$db->prefix}webdecoy_detections ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3", ARRAY_A); }
    error_log('WebDecoy Playground diagnostic: '.json_encode($d));
});

<?php define('WEBDECOY_DISABLE', true); require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; global $wpdb; $n=(int)$wpdb->get_var("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {$wpdb->prefix}webdecoy_detections WHERE user_agent = 'WebDecoy-Test/1.0 Playground'"); if ($n !== 1) { throw new Exception('Expected exactly one setup-test record, got '.$n); } if (!empty(get_option('webdecoy_options')['api_key'])) { throw new Exception('Unexpected reporting credential'); } echo json_encode(['webdecoy_playground_verified'=>true,'controlled_test_records'=>$n,'cloud_key_configured'=>false]);
